1.explanation: This snippet mounts a Carbon React ExpandableTile with one span above and one below the fold. In practice, VO should announce the above-the-fold text on entry (and expose aria-expanded on the toggle), and should not read the below-the-fold content until after the tile is expanded. As written today, VO (and similarly JAWS) will silently land on the tile (no announcement), read only “Expand button main” without aria-expanded state, then will immediately read both sections in a single navigation step. Use this code in Chrome/Mac with VoiceOver (or Firefox/Windows with JAWS) to reproduce the described issue.
1.bug_scenario: A minimal Carbon React ExpandableTile is rendered with both “above the fold” and “below the fold” content. When using VoiceOver on macOS and navigating into the tile via Control-Option-Shift-Down Arrow, nothing is announced on entry (so you land on a generic text container without hearing the above-the-fold text). Tabbing or moving focus to the expand button announces only “Expand button main” without its aria-expanded state. Further arrow navigation immediately reads both the above-the-fold and below-the-fold text even though the tile is still collapsed.
